## QF-MVP-50.5 — RECOVERY SUPERVISOR (SELF-HOSTED STAGING CANDIDATE)

**KEEP INACTIVE / UNPUBLISHED.**

Default path is fail-closed because `QF_N8N_TRANSPORT_ENABLED` must equal `true`.

Secrets are runtime env references only; never paste secret values into this workflow.

Required later on self-hosted n8n: `QF_CORE_STAGING_BASE_URL`, `QF_N8N_WORKER_ID`, `QF_N8N_TO_CORE_HMAC_SECRET`, `QF_CORE_TO_N8N_HMAC_SECRET`, `QF_N8N_TRANSPORT_ENABLED`. **No new variable is introduced by 50.5.**

### TWO INDEPENDENT LANES, ON PURPOSE

`reconcile` and `recover` have their OWN schedule trigger, so they run as separate n8n executions. A failure, a rejection or a slow response in one lane therefore cannot starve the other — which a single fan-out branch could not guarantee. Fresh `pending` work is a third lane entirely, owned by the certified client/vendor/campaign executors and untouched here.

Each lane does at most ONE unit of work per cycle. Reconciliation runs every 5 minutes because nothing is reconcilable until the Core-owned staleness threshold has elapsed; recovery runs every minute so a due retry is picked up promptly.

### n8n OWNS NO BUSINESS AUTHORITY HERE

It sends three identity fields to `recover` and `reconcile`. It never selects the job, the action, the workflow family, the classification, the retry time, the stale outcome, the dead-letter decision, the provider, the recipient or the template. On a successful recovery it routes ONLY on the Core-returned `workflowFamily`, through a closed three-entry map, to the EXISTING certified execute boundary — and an unrecognised family produces no route at all.

The `reconcile` lane makes NO follow-up call of any kind. Whatever Core decided is final for this cycle.

### WHAT THIS WORKFLOW CANNOT DO

It cannot claim fresh work (`claim_v1` is not reachable from here). It cannot retry a communication row — where the communication lane owns a send, Core answers `reconcile_deferred` and this graph stops. It cannot decide that a job is dead: `dead_letter` is computed inside `qf_complete_automation_attempt_v1` and nowhere else.

The certified QF-MVP-50.2E / 50.3 / 50.4 executor workflows are NOT modified by this phase.
